methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR expert consensus (155 experts, Aug. 23)
FantasyPros independent boards including Scott Bogman (Aug. 22) and Andrew Erickson updates through Aug. 24
CBS Sports Week 2 preseason riser/faller analysis (Aug. 23)
NFL.com and Reuters late-August injury reporting
methodology.marketInput: Current FantasyPros aggregated ADP remains the primary market-price input, with Sleeper-specific ADP cross-checked on player pages where available. ADP is a price signal, not a substitute for player value.
newsInputs: Ashton Jeanty suffered a right ankle sprain in Raiders practice Aug. 23. ESPN/NFL Network reporting says it is not expected to be long-term, but the severity and return timetable remain unknown; Mike Washington Jr. is the immediate contingency. This is a material value change because Jeanty had been priced as a late first/early second-round back.

Christian McCaffrey returned to practice Aug. 23 after nearly three weeks of being held out for generalized tightness. Week 1 remains the target, reducing but not eliminating the preseason injury discount.
Malik Nabers returned to team sessions and could shed the red non-contact jersey during the week of Aug. 24. His recovery remains incomplete, but the direction of travel is positive.
Seattle held primary starters such as Jaxon Smith-Njigba out of the Aug. 23 preseason game, so no negative usage inference is taken from the finale of Week 2 preseason action.
No new suspension or trade involving another top-30 player was found that justified a larger value move in this refresh.
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertLow/expertHigh ranges; unresolved injuries can intentionally widen those ranges. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. The Aug. 24 refresh makes a material downgrade to Ashton Jeanty while preserving his still-aggressive market price as a separate ADP signal. McCaffrey and Nabers receive modest recovery-driven adjustments rather than full injury erasures. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.
